research_question: What is the causal effect of [TREATMENT] on [OUTCOME] for [POPULATION]?
background: This is a template framing document that can be customized for specific causal inference projects. Replace the bracketed placeholders with your specific research context.

variables.name: outcome
variables.description: Primary outcome variable to be measured

estimand.description: Average treatment effect across the entire target population
estimand.target_population: All units in the study sample

study_design.description: Observational study where treatment assignment occurs naturally

assumptions.name: Conditional Independence
assumptions.description: Treatment assignment is independent of potential outcomes given observed covariates
assumptions.test_method: Balance tests after propensity score adjustment
assumptions.rationale: Core assumption for identifying causal effects in observational studies

assumptions.name: Positivity
assumptions.description: Every covariate combination has non-zero probability of receiving each treatment level
assumptions.rationale: Ensures overlap between treatment groups for valid comparison

assumptions.name: Consistency
assumptions.description: The observed outcome for each unit equals its potential outcome under the actual treatment received
assumptions.rationale: Links potential outcomes framework to observed data

validation_criteria.name: Covariate Balance
validation_criteria.description: Standardized mean differences between treatment groups should be minimal after adjustment
validation_criteria.test: Calculate standardized mean differences for all covariates

validation_criteria.name: Overlap Assessment
validation_criteria.description: Propensity scores should show sufficient overlap between treatment groups

validation_criteria.name: Model Specification
validation_criteria.description: Statistical models should be correctly specified

data_requirements.data_structure: Tabular dataset with one row per observation unit

limitations: Unmeasured confounding may bias effect estimates
Results may not generalize beyond study population
Cross-sectional design limits causal inference for temporal relationships
